The '''Mummer Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Nestled deep within the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], a short distance west of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]], the cave was used as a base of operations for the criminal organization known as the [[Mummers]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:GtPfaS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Tanoa Vills]] dispatched a spacer to the cave in order to get an [[XJ5 circuit board]] from Mummer scientists. This allowed Vills to build a sequencer that can be used in a [[Stonewall Labs]] security beacon.<ref name="SWG:GtPfaS" /> Around the same time, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Eom Nia]] ordered a young [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] to attack the Mummers in the cave as part of his [[Officer/Legends|officer]] combat training.<ref name="SWG:OM2">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Officer Mission 2|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mummer Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GtPfaS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mummer Cave was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]],"<ref name="SWG:GtPfaS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
